svg.title: The nature of the claim
svg.desc: The claim is that this theorem follows from these axioms. Mathlib's axioms go through Lean's kernel, which checks every step, to the theorem. The proof is a closed logical object whose correctness is internal consistency; empirical validation is not required. A reader can still examine what the definitions say.
